inputs.text: [excited] OH… vih… RAP… tor. "Ovi," in Latin, [serious] means egg — like in "oval." And "raptor" is thief. [curious] So what does that give us?
[happily] That's its name. [proud] It lived in Asia, in the Mongolian desert, seventy-five million years ago.
[curious] Is it a cousin of the raptors, [gasps] like Velociraptor?
[confident] A cousin, yes, [amazed] but this one had no teeth — a beak, a pretty colorful crest, almost like a parrot.
[gasps] An egg thief? [nervous] That's not very nice.
[gently] Wait for the end of the story. [warmly] It doesn't deserve that name at all.
